title: After the Satsuki Sho: You're Strong

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The racers come charging furiously down the track! Can the pack leader evade their dogged pursuit?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Haaah…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Oh no, I can already hear the others approaching. Their acceleration is completely different to anything I've experienced before!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to win… I need to win… I have to win… That's all that matters right now!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I won't surrender the crown to anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew… Hey, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: R-Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Ines & Ryan
text_block_list.text: See you at the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You know, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way back to the waiting room, Ines Fujin turns to me, still tentatively cradling her overheated limbs.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Having everyone's focus on me like that… it felt completely different from any other race I've experienced so far.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. They were on a completely different level.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It might be a heck of a lot tougher to win the Derby than I imagined.
choice_data_list: But that's your dream, isn't it?
But that's your dream, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha, well… After running this race, I'm feeling more motivated than ever!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It really hit me! I want to be faster than anyone else and lead the pack!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So I'm gonna get even better! I've got to get faster and faster…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Because I want to win.
choice_data_list: I'll lead you to victory as the favorite!
I'll lead you to victory as the favorite!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm gonna hold you to that, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Seriously though, that might feel pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I'll go out there with everyone's eyes on me like today… I'll face them head-on… and I'll snatch victory out from under their noses!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on TV
text_block_list.text: "Since I was born an Umamusume, I always felt it was my calling to become a Derby champion."

text_block_list.name: Interview Transcript
text_block_list.text: "For us Umamusume, there's one title that we all dream of acquiring."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I am an Umamusume, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, so tomorrow is a day off, but we'll get stuck into training the day after that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Have a good night, Trainer. Sweet dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, winning as the favorite? You've got pretty high hopes for me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh—whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… That was a close call! It'd be super embarrassing if I got injured by being careless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "If it matters to you, it matters to me, too."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "If it matters to you, it matters to me, too."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: When we first started, you supported me in continuing my part-time work despite my training obligations.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Now, I want to fulfill my side of the bargain and make your dream come true too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So let's make this Derby ours, Trainer.
